item.title: 23 changes to the run order
item.description:
23 changes to the run order

  • Saturday: CA Funny Car Qualifying 2 removed from the run order
  • Saturday: Group 2 Eliminations removed from the run order
  • Saturday: D/Gas Qualifying 2 added to the run order, after Nostalgia Eliminator 2 Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: C/Gas Qualifying 2 added to the run order, after D/Gas Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: Pro Comp Qualifying 1 added to the run order, after AFX Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: Junior Fuel Qualifying 1 added to the run order, after 7.0 Pro Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: Outlaw Gassers Time Trial 2 added to the run order, after Pro Mod Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: CA Funny Cars Qualifying 1 added to the run order, after Outlaw Gassers Time Trial 2
  • Saturday: Outlaw Gassers Time Trial 3 added to the run order, after C/Gas Round 1
  • Saturday: Secure added to the run order at 6:00 PM
  • Saturday: Nostalgia Eliminator 3 changed from Round 1 to Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: Nostalgia Eliminator 2 changed from Round 1 to Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: B/Gas changed from Round 1 to Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: Nostalgia Eliminator 1 changed from Round 1 to Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: A/Gas changed from Round 1 to Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: AFX changed from Round 1 to Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: Pro Mod changed from Qualifying 3 to Qualifying 1
  • Saturday: Nostalgia Top Fuel Qualifying 2 moved from 12:30 PM to 12:15 PM
  • Saturday: Nostalgia Funny Car changed from Round 1 to Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: 7.0 Pro changed from Round 1 to Qualifying 2
  • Saturday: Pro Mod Qualifying 2 no longer has a set time (was 12:00 PM); it follows the run order
  • Saturday: Jets changed from EX to Ex
  • Saturday: Cacklefest no longer has a set time (was 6:00 PM); it follows the run order

All run orders are subject to change. Times are shown exactly as published by the event.
